languages.name: HTML
languages.description: HTML reference focused on semantic structure, forms, accessibility, browser integration, and UI authoring.

entries.title: <!doctype html>
entries.summary: Declare an HTML5 document and standards rendering mode.
entries.definition: Declare an HTML5 document and standards rendering mode.
entries.mental_model: A tiny switch that tells the browser to use modern standards mode.

examples.title: Example
examples.explanation: Creates the outer HTML document skeleton.

entries.title: <html>
entries.summary: Represent the root element of an HTML document.
entries.definition: Represent the root element of an HTML document.
entries.mental_model: Everything rendered belongs under this root.

examples.title: Example
examples.explanation: Defines the document root and language.

entries.title: <head>
entries.summary: Contain metadata, title, links, styles, and scripts not rendered as main page content.
entries.definition: Contain metadata, title, links, styles, and scripts not rendered as main page content.
entries.mental_model: Configuration and metadata for the document.

entries.title: <meta>
entries.summary: Provide document metadata such as charset and viewport settings.
entries.definition: Provide document metadata such as charset and viewport settings.
entries.mental_model: Key-value metadata consumed by browsers and other agents.

entries.title: <link>
entries.summary: Associate external resources such as stylesheets and icons.
entries.definition: Associate external resources such as stylesheets and icons.
entries.mental_model: Declare document-to-resource relationships.

entries.title: <script>
entries.summary: Embed or load executable JavaScript.
entries.definition: Embed or load executable JavaScript.
entries.mental_model: Connects HTML structure to executable behavior.

categories.name: Semantic Content
categories.description: Elements that express page meaning and hierarchy.

entries.title: <header>
entries.summary: Represent introductory or navigational content for a page or section.
entries.definition: Represent introductory or navigational content for a page or section.
entries.mental_model: Use meaning-bearing containers instead of generic divs when possible.

entries.title: <nav>
entries.summary: Represent a major navigation region.
entries.definition: Represent a major navigation region.
entries.mental_model: Helps browsers and assistive technology identify navigation.

entries.title: <main>
entries.summary: Mark the document's primary unique content.
entries.definition: Mark the document's primary unique content.
entries.mental_model: One dominant main landmark per page is the usual pattern.

entries.title: <section>
entries.summary: Group thematically related content, usually with a heading.
entries.definition: Group thematically related content, usually with a heading.
entries.mental_model: Semantic grouping, not merely visual grouping.

entries.title: <article>
entries.summary: Represent self-contained content that could stand independently.
entries.definition: Represent self-contained content that could stand independently.
entries.mental_model: Useful for posts, cards with independent meaning, docs entries, etc.

entries.title: <button>
entries.summary: Represent an interactive button action.
entries.definition: Represent an interactive button action.
entries.mental_model: Use buttons for actions, links for navigation.

entries.title: <form>
entries.summary: Group controls that can submit user-provided data.
entries.definition: Group controls that can submit user-provided data.
entries.mental_model: Defines a submission/control context.

entries.title: <label>
entries.summary: Associate human-readable text with a form control.
entries.definition: Associate human-readable text with a form control.
entries.mental_model: Labels are part of the control's accessible name.

entries.title: <input>
entries.summary: Create single-value controls such as text, checkbox, file, number, and more.
entries.definition: Create single-value controls such as text, checkbox, file, number, and more.
entries.mental_model: The type attribute selects specialized browser behavior.

entries.title: <textarea>
entries.summary: Create a multi-line text input control.
entries.definition: Create a multi-line text input control.
entries.mental_model: Use for user-editable blocks of text.

entries.title: <select>
entries.summary: Create a list/select control from option elements.
entries.definition: Create a list/select control from option elements.
entries.mental_model: A constrained set of submitted choices.

entries.title: <table>
entries.summary: Represent genuinely tabular relationships between rows and columns.
entries.definition: Represent genuinely tabular relationships between rows and columns.
entries.mental_model: Use tables for data, not page layout.

entries.summary: Embed an image with meaningful alternative text when appropriate.
entries.definition: Embed an image with meaningful alternative text when appropriate.
entries.mental_model: alt describes meaning when the image cannot be perceived.

entries.title: ARIA labels
entries.summary: Provide accessible naming/semantics when native HTML alone is insufficient.
entries.definition: Provide accessible naming/semantics when native HTML alone is insufficient.
entries.mental_model: Prefer native semantics first, then ARIA to fill genuine gaps.

examples.title: Example
examples.explanation: Adds an accessible label to the nav landmark.

entries.title: data-* attributes
entries.summary: Attach application-specific string data to elements.
entries.definition: Attach application-specific string data to elements.
entries.mental_model: A standards-compliant bridge between markup and JavaScript behavior.

examples.title: Example
examples.explanation: Stores custom metadata on an element.

entries.title: <template>
entries.summary: Store inert HTML fragments for later cloning by JavaScript.
entries.definition: Store inert HTML fragments for later cloning by JavaScript.
entries.mental_model: HTML that exists in the document but is not rendered until instantiated.
